FA-CHALLENGE-COVERAGE.rationale: This guard has changed repeatedly and may reject a semantically valid challenge artifact; resolve from fixture evidence.

FA-CHALLENGE-NOT-SUPPORTED.rationale: The model emitted a behavioral challenge that was not supported.

FA-DUPLICATE-IDENTITY.rationale: The model emitted duplicate inspection, observation, or challenge identifiers.

FA-INSPECTION-COVERAGE.rationale: This guard has changed repeatedly and may reject a semantically valid inspection artifact; resolve from fixture evidence.

FA-INSPECTION-NOT-VERIFIED.rationale: The model accepted a requirement whose inspection was not verified.

FA-MISSING-CHALLENGE.rationale: The model omitted the challenge required for a behavioral requirement.

FA-MISSING-EVIDENCE.rationale: The model accepted a requirement without any evidence reference.

FA-MISSING-INSPECTION.rationale: The model accepted a requirement without an inspection artifact.

FA-UNKNOWN-INSPECTION-REQUIREMENT.rationale: The model emitted an inspection outside the finalizer contract.

FA-UNKNOWN-OBSERVATION-REQUIREMENT.rationale: The model emitted an observation outside the finalizer contract.

IA-INVALID-ABSENCE-OF-CHANGE.rationale: Rung 2 showed identical blank-source ABSENCE_OF_CHANGE nominations accepted after inspector binding but rejected at finalization, where no equivalent binding was available.

IA-INVALID-EVIDENCE-RANGE.rationale: Range validity depends on application-bound reads and may reject a semantically valid artifact; resolve from fixture evidence.

IA-INVALID-OBSERVATION-REFERENCE.evidence: RF-14-41504759 run 11: the ref cited source_id obs-validation3-test-code while the declared observation id was obs-validation3-code. The model referenced an observation it never emitted.
IA-INVALID-OBSERVATION-REFERENCE.rationale: The guard may reject a valid observation because application-side observation identity is wrong; resolve from fixture evidence.

IA-INVALID-READ-REFERENCE.rationale: A valid model artifact may still be rejected if the application-side read binding is wrong; resolve from fixture evidence.

IA-MISSING-ABSENCE-OF-CHANGE.rationale: F1 confirmed that positive diff evidence cannot prove a negative structural claim; the model must request application-bound ABSENCE_OF_CHANGE authority.

IA-MISSING-ASSERTION-OR-SIGNAL.rationale: This required-proof guard may be over-constrained for a semantically valid test artifact; resolve from fixture evidence.

IA-MISSING-DIRECT-CODE-OBSERVATION.rationale: RF-016 omitted required CODE observations for three behavioral requirements, then satisfied the unchanged guard on correction using the available source evidence.

IA-MISSING-DIRECT-EXECUTION-EVIDENCE.evidence: RF-12-deb019b0 plan:step:3 is classified VALIDATION and states an expected total, so execution evidence is exactly what proves it; the model cited none.
IA-MISSING-DIRECT-EXECUTION-EVIDENCE.rationale: This required-proof guard may be over-constrained for a semantically valid validation artifact; resolve from fixture evidence.

IA-MISSING-EXECUTION-SOURCE.rationale: The guard may reject a semantically valid reference when trusted execution context is absent or misbound; resolve from fixture evidence.

IA-MISSING-STRUCTURAL-EVIDENCE.rationale: RF-13 supplied a directory pseudo-reference that canonical binding correctly dropped, then satisfied the unchanged non-empty-reference guard on correction.

IA-OBSERVATION-PATH-MISMATCH.rationale: This authority binding has changed repeatedly and may reject a semantically valid artifact; resolve from fixture evidence.

IA-UNGROUNDED-OBSERVATION.rationale: RF-14-52e49d5a claimed Item.java lines 1-6 when the authoritative ledger returned only lines 1-5; the guard correctly rejected the ungrounded range.

IA-UNKNOWN-EXECUTION-SOURCE.evidence: CORRECTED from A to B. RF-016 run 20 raised this at the FINALIZATION stage, not INSPECTION. The finalizer cited source_id "exec-evidence-bebb9cc...ba8d}]},{'" -- the real id with JSON fragments appended by malformed model output. That string is genuinely not in the trusted set, so the guard was correct. The earlier Class A reading came from checking the inspection artifact, whose refs were valid, rather than the stage that actually raised the problem.
IA-UNKNOWN-EXECUTION-SOURCE.rationale: The guard may reject a valid model citation because application evidence identity is misbound; resolve from fixture evidence.

IA-UNTRUSTED-DIFF-PATH.rationale: The guard depends on application-owned changed-file authority; resolve whether a valid artifact can be rejected from fixture evidence.

IA-WRONG-OBSERVATION-REQUIREMENT.rationale: Requirement ownership is partly application-derived, so semantic validity cannot be decided without fixture evidence.

IA-WRONG-REQUIREMENT-REFERENCE.rationale: Whether this reference is semantically wrong or the authority guard is over-constrained requires fixture evidence.

II-UNKNOWN-INSPECTION-REQUIREMENT.rationale: The model emitted an inspection for an unknown requirement.

II-UNKNOWN-OBSERVATION-REQUIREMENT.rationale: The model emitted an observation for an unknown requirement.

RC-DUPLICATE-REQUIREMENT.rationale: The model emitted the same requirement check more than once.

RC-REQUIREMENT-COVERAGE.rationale: The model omitted or added requirement checks relative to the supplied contract.

RC-UNEXPECTED-REQUIREMENT.rationale: The model emitted a requirement identifier outside the supplied contract.

RC-UNSATISFIED-REQUIREMENT.rationale: The model marked an accepted requirement as not satisfied.

SP-CLUSTER-HASH-MISMATCH.rationale: The model supplied a specialist cluster hash inconsistent with its excerpt.

SP-CURRENT-BLOCKING-FINDING.rationale: The model emitted a current blocking specialist finding while accepting.

SP-DUPLICATE-ASSOCIATION.rationale: The model emitted duplicate specialist candidate associations.

SP-DUPLICATE-EVIDENCE-CLUSTER.rationale: The model emitted duplicate specialist evidence cluster identifiers.

SP-DUPLICATE-FINDING.rationale: The model emitted duplicate specialist finding identifiers.

SP-INAPPLICABLE-STAGE-NOT-SKIPPED.rationale: The model failed to skip a specialist stage that was inapplicable.

SP-INVALID-FINDING-PROVENANCE.rationale: The model emitted a finding whose provenance does not validate.

SP-MISSING-ASSOCIATION.rationale: The model omitted a candidate association for an emitted finding.

SP-REQUIRED-STAGE-INCOMPLETE.rationale: The model failed to complete a specialist stage required by its evidence.

SP-STAGE-APPLICABILITY-MISMATCH.rationale: The model's specialist applicability flag disagreed with the evidence.

SP-UNKNOWN-ASSOCIATED-FINDING.rationale: The model associated a candidate with a finding it did not emit.
